purpose: Canonical label taxonomy for new and updated Agentweaver issues. The sync-squad-labels workflow reads this file for managed static labels; squad member labels are generated from .squad/team.md.

deprecatedLabels.bug: Use type:bug for new or relabeled issues.
deprecatedLabels.enhancement: Use type:feature for new or relabeled issues.
deprecatedLabels.workstream:*: Use the narrower area:* vocabulary for new or relabeled issues. Existing issues are intentionally not mass-migrated.

managedLabels.description: Research/investigation — produces a plan, not code

managedLabels.name: type:epic
managedLabels.description: Parent issue that decomposes into sub-issues

managedLabels.name: release:v0.x
